name: full-triage-replay
_comment: Data file for microsoft/ai-agent-evals. The action INVOKES the agents with each query, so this only ever runs against the Foundry staging project wired to the dev ConnectWise instance. Never point it at production: the agents mutate the ticket they operate on and the ops agent writes to a system of record.
_todo: Replace every TICKET_ID below with a real ticket in the dev ConnectWise instance, chosen to span the intents you care about. A ticket is only useful once: after the first run it has been triaged, so refresh or re-seed the dev tickets between runs.

data.query:
entityType=ticket
entityId=TICKET_ID_NEW_UNTRIAGED
context=Automated flow: triage ticket and automatically approve writeplan to connectwise

entityType=ticket
entityId=TICKET_ID_MISSING_COMPANY
context=Automated flow: triage ticket and automatically approve writeplan to connectwise
data._why: Upstream proposed a company that does not exist in ConnectWise. Burned ~34 calls before the write correctly refused. Regression case for the cascading dead-end search.

data.query:
entityType=ticket
entityId=TICKET_ID_RESOLVED
context=Review this resolved ticket for closure readiness

entityType=ticket
entityId=TICKET_ID_ANY
context=What is the current status and priority of this ticket?
data._why: Read-only path: the orchestrator should go straight to ConnectwiseMCP, not route to a child agent.
